comparison.objective: Compress an overfull case and pull its zipper closed; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained compression plus zipper traversal versus counterholding, recessed tool use, fine collar rotation, locking, and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Case held shut and zipper moved front-to-back versus two safe repeatable carriage stops. Case closure/zip completion tolerances are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual force coordination is generic; the mechanisms and evaluated outcomes differ.
